prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. ONE woman.

a warm caramel complexion, late 30s goddess, glamour hourglass physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — a stunning hourglass figure, far more dramatically curved than any ordinary woman; a full, rounded bust, a dramatically narrow, sharply cinched waist with a deep shadowed groove running around her middle, and wide, curvaceous hips flaring well beyond her shoulders, soft rounded thighs, toned but soft arms; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other, top bun golden blonde hair — wearing nothing but glowing neon tube light as her only outfit, every tube as thick as her thumb and blazing at full brightness: the top is a bandeau of three stacked horizontal turquoise neon tubes wrapped across her chest and covering it completely, with one turquoise neon tube loop rising from the center of the bandeau up around her neck as a halter, and the bottom is a panty formed by a dense coil of amber neon tube filling the front and covering her hips completely, with a single tube rising along each side to her hip bones; thin black cables run from the tubes down behind her, and every other part of her body, her shoulders, arms, stomach, thighs, legs, face and hands, is plain bare real skin washed in the colored glow of the tubes. Real photographic skin across her whole body, with visible pores and fine grain, fine peach-fuzz hairs and a faint natural flush on her cheeks and chest, a light scatter of faint freckles across her shoulders and upper arms and fine blue-green veins on the backs of her hands. Her skin tone runs naturally across every area outside the tubes. Pose: standing just behind the foreground landmark, weight on one leg with the other leg crossed in front, one hand resting on her outer hip and the other arm hanging relaxed at her side, chin lifted, looking at the camera, her legs fully in view — most extreme glamour hourglass silhouette ever displayed.
Footwear: heels of the most absurdly extreme height imaginable, strappy platform stiletto sandals made of glossy royal purple leather, each with a razor-thin tapered heel a full forty inches tall and a twelve-inch hidden front platform, her feet arched fully vertical on the very tips of her toes like a dancer on pointe, her legs stretched impossibly long and her whole body lifted far above the ground on them as if standing on stilts.
Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, ballerina nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in royal purple lacquer with a high polish.
Jewelry: a pair of oversized sculpted earrings of blackened iron and bright silver as her only jewelry, her neck, collarbones, chest, arms, wrists and fingers plain bare skin.
Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Latina woman with high cheekbones, large dark eyes and full lips, an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: extremely heavy, fully saturated and bold, never subtle, faded or blended away: a bold black graphic crease line drawn high above each eyelid, very thick false lashes on the top lids, small painted lash strokes beneath each lower lid, soft lilac-white eyeshadow, large eyes with bright real catchlights, natural brows, a soft peachy-white lip.

Background: a real famous place photographed at true scale, a real container terminal with a huge container ship moored at the quay, stacks of colorful shipping containers and tall blue gantry cranes placed in the foreground close to the camera at the bottom centre of the frame, rising only to the height of her waist and thighs, tiny trucks, tiny forklifts and tiny dock workers around its base at their real size appearing as small as ants; she is a colossal giant standing just behind and slightly to one side of the foreground landmark, so that it overlaps only part of her legs and clearly shows how much taller than it she is, her towering heels planted on the concrete quay, a soft hazy dusk sky behind her, the whole place clearly visible and in focus, lit by soft dusk light with the port floodlights glowing and gentle shadows. ONE woman only. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at knee height, the famous foreground landmark large at the bottom centre of the frame and she standing just behind it, the whole figure from the soles of her shoes to the top of her head completely visible, with the real people, vehicles and trees around her ankles shown at their true size so her colossal height and the extreme heel height read at a glance, the towering heels clearly separating the shoes from the floor. This is one single photograph taken with one camera at one moment, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/5.6, realistic photographic grain, a real photograph. Portrait 2:3 aspect ratio.
